static_publisher_transport.fixture_body_provenance: old package-release render copied only to exercise static byte transport

typed_input.unknown_product_id_result: `[[declare]]` primitive `package-release` does not accept the argument `product_id`; accepted arguments: build_tasks, channel, concurrency_group, consumer_branch, consumer_repository, github_release_type, manifest_schema, package_dir, payloads, publish_environment, release_tag, release_title_prefix, source_ref, source_repository, supporting_assets, update_commit_message, updater, updater_token_secret

b_semantic_gaps: No product_id, purpose, or platform config keys; product_id is rejected as an unknown primitive argument
Tag is RELEASE_TAG plus full source SHA, not closure16; generic lane also force-refreshes mutable RELEASE_TAG
Only build/publish jobs; no fixed build-linux-x64, reserve-release, isolated attest, verify-B, numeric artifact/job/check binding, or custom B predicate
Publish permissions include pull-requests: write and an updater secret
Consumer checkout, branch push, and consumer PR creation are intrinsic
Generated setup invokes renderer/policy revision; omitted config revision falls back to binary source revision
Existing runtime-products publisher is fixed to the application and three platforms, so reuse violates namespace/platform separation
Static files copy bytes only and do not establish semantic authority

main_push_observation.ordering_verdict: runtime native cell starts before old Policy; post-push B cannot retroactively transfer old Policy or prevent that cell

preflight_assertions.requirement: Immediately before merge, live base ref SHA equals captured base CAS; post-merge parent order is (BASE_SHA, PR_HEAD_SHA), exact tree and lease match
preflight_assertions.negative: base drift, PR head/tree drift, second writer, or merge response mismatch aborts; no ETag assumption

preflight_assertions.requirement: Exact App/installation/Checks integration, repository, workflow path/SHA, event, head/base/tree, run/attempt/job/check IDs bind the check
preflight_assertions.negative: context-name-only, wrong provider, stale attempt, duplicate integration, or unbound status rejects

preflight_assertions.requirement: DCO and ci-required plus every exact premerge child run/check attempt terminal success, non-neutral, non-skipped, exact PR tree
preflight_assertions.negative: green aggregate with skipped/absent/queued/cancelled/wrong-SHA child rejects

preflight_assertions.requirement: Signed lease binds operator, base, PR/tree, ruleset hashes, expiry, endpoints, watchdog and independent recovery actor; freeze bypass/writers
preflight_assertions.negative: missing expiry, shared builder/recovery identity, stale lease, or unverified full-object ruleset PUT blocks

preflight_assertions.requirement: First resulting-main run has exact Linux-X64, Linux-ARM64, xcode-27 and publish jobs, all terminal success, exact SHA/attempt
preflight_assertions.negative: macos-15, macos-26, missing/empty/skipped Mac, fallback, or B replacing application publisher rejects

preflight_assertions.requirement: Nonzero draft release ID precedes manifest; exact closure16 tag, main target, one Linux-X64 asset, raw/inner/binary digests, numeric run/job/check/artifact IDs and signed predicate; publish then reverify live APIs
preflight_assertions.negative: zero ID, mutable latest, overwrite, name/run-only binding, app namespace, candidate/fork source, or missing binding rejects

preflight_assertions.requirement: Base policy has a direct dependency on verified B in the exact run before required Policy emits, while DCO and all CI children remain required
preflight_assertions.negative: B published after old Policy, wrapper/context shortcut, candidate result, or old checker remaining authoritative rejects

conclusion: Under no-new-policy-field, no-permanent-B-pin, no-application-publisher-reuse, no-compatibility-sidecar, and no-candidate-authority constraints, no existing input proves the actual B contract. package-release is old-parser-safe but semantically rejected; static_files is transport-only. Require owner-supplied reviewed B source body and protected pre-main authority/handoff before any approval.
